aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparative evidence but misgroups the changed factor and has drop-test and conclusion handling errors.
issues: Auto/manual drop tests are outcome subgroups, not changed conditions.
Manual drop comparison cites auto normal row instead of manual normal row.
Function table shows higher NG for test while text says OK/same normal.
Bond spread result is omitted as an outcome or limitation.
Decision rows are not used to qualify conclusions.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to plate ring color level 4 material from Myungjin versus Normal.
Move auto/manual drop labels to reliability subresults and pair manual test with row 39.
Record function numeric result as worse and note conflicting textual conclusion.
Add bond spread condition result as a separate outcome or stated limitation.
Add decision/conclusion rows 51-58 as evidence for final judgement context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but key citations and grouping are insufficient for final evidence.
